mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recipe_images (recipe_id, image_url, caption, is_cover, sort_order) VALUES (#{recipeId}, #{imageUrl}, #{caption}, #{isCover}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.select: SELECT id, recipe_id, image_url, caption, is_cover, sort_order, created_at, updated_at FROM recipe_images WHERE recipe_id = #{recipeId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC
